fields.summary_ko.0: Visa (V) Q4 adjusted EPS of $3.48 (17% YoY increase) exceeded consensus of $3.44, but stock declined 1.4% in after-hours trading.
fields.summary_ko.1: Annual net revenues of $4.6B (15% increase), EPS of $13.27 (16% increase) recorded; high-value services revenue up 30% and client incentives surged 21%, serving as headwinds.
fields.summary_ko.2: FY2027 outlook projects net revenues in low double-digit growth and EPS in low double-digit to low-teens growth; some investors cite insufficient growth momentum; 16% increase in quarterly dividend implemented.
